text:
incident-bot: PAGER: sev-1 — warmup/model-load cascade failures in dedicated pool us-west-2-east. Symptoms: deserialization errors, compile timeouts, CUDA OOMs, and two node flaps. Several containers crashlooping.

emma-ml-oncall: I'm taking this. posting triage in 2.

carlos-sre: oncall here. any initial indicators? memory pressure, disk, network?

emma-ml-oncall: initial correlation: model=open-70b-v1-qat (quant path=fp4-8) warmup jobs failing during load/unmarshal and then hitting compile step which OOMs. model-load-bot shows batch of 30 warmups triggered at 03:12 UTC.

mira-runtime-lead: observed spike in compile_attempts and short compile-timeout retry storms. Also two nodes reported kubelet NotReady for ~40s each right around 03:14 UTC — likely caused by repeated OOM kills.

jake-eng-oncall: logs from a failing warmup: ```
[2026-05-10T03:12:16Z] model_open: fetching shard 12
[2026-05-10T03:12:18Z] ERROR: model unmarshal: unexpected EOF while deserializing tensor metadata
[2026-05-10T03:12:19Z] falling back to deserialized-path -> trigger compile
[2026-05-10T03:12:22Z] compile: kernel link start
[2026-05-10T03:12:45Z] WARN: compile duration=33s, retrying
[2026-05-10T03:12:47Z] ERROR: cudaOutOfMemory: alloc failed 1.4GiB
[2026-05-10T03:12:48Z] cgroup: oom_kill process 4012
```

model-load-bot: ALERT: 27/35 warmup jobs failed in pool us-west-2-east within 5m.

carlos-sre: immediate mitigations proposed: 1) disable warmup for pool to stop creating new compiles 2) apply fallback routing to open-70b-v1-compact (reduced memory) 3) throttle compile concurrency to 1 4) increase compile timeout and backoff so retries don't spin.

emma-ml-oncall: applying config patch now: warmup.enabled=false on pool us-west-2-east.

deploy-bot: config change started (cfg-20260510-raw1) by emma-ml-oncall  rolling to 12 nodes.

mira-runtime-lead: I'm pushing a hotfix to model loader to treat transient deserialization EOF as retry-with-backoff rather than immediate compile trigger. This should reduce sudden compile storms. Deploying hotfix hf-705.

deploy-bot: hotfix deploy hf-705 started by mira-runtime-lead.

jean (from infra): noticing two nodes flapped to NotReady; they are rebooting from OOM stress. I'll cordon them and move workloads.

jake-eng-oncall: route override created: match(pool==us-west-2-east && model==open-70b-v1) -> fallback=open-70b-v1-compact. policy pol-0705 applied.

deploy-bot: route override pol-0705 applied. compile_concurrency=1 enforced for pool. compile_timeout increased 30->120s.

oliver-cs: customer impact: approx 15 Dedicated tenants in this region saw elevated 5xxs and degraded throughput for generation calls between 03:12-03:40 UTC. Draft message ready, holding for stability window.

emma-ml-oncall: metrics: OOM kill rate dropped from 9/min to 0.5/min after warmup disable and route override. node flaps prevented after cordon.

mira-runtime-lead: also added temporary jitter to warmup scheduling to avoid thundering herd when we re-enable. will revert aggressive compile-cache eviction behavior (recent change) as part of full rollback.

carlos-sre: timeline so far:
- 03:12 UTC: batch warmup triggered for open-70b-v1-qat -> many cache misses
- 03:13-03:15 UTC: deserialization errors + compile attempts spike
- 03:14 UTC: two nodes hit OOM and NotReady briefly -> kube reschedules some pods -> additional cold loads
- 03:18 UTC: warmup disabled, fallback route applied, compile concurrency throttled
- 03:22 UTC: hotfix deployed to reduce immediate compile triggers on unmarshal errors

jake-eng-oncall: hotfix and config changes appear to be effective. compile-hit-rate improving, load failures down. no new OOMs in last 18m.

oliver-cs: recommending customer notification now. Proposed text: "We experienced transient model load and warmup failures that resulted in intermittent request failures for a subset of Dedicated customers in us-west-2-east. We applied mitigations and the service has stabilized. No data exposure. Postmortem will follow with root cause and actions." Approve?

carlos-sre: hold for 30m watch; if stable, send.

~40m later~

emmaj-ml-oncall: (note: typo in handle, actually emma-ml-oncall) stability check: pool healthy for 35m, compile cache hit-rate > 90%, no further deserialization errors observed.

jake-eng-oncall: re-enable warmup with staged rollout: warmup.enabled=true on 2 nodes, jitter=10-30s, compile_concurrency=1, monitor.

deploy-bot: staged config applied (cfg-20260510-raw2).

mira-runtime-lead: action items for postmortem (owners):
- revert compile-cache eviction tweak and add e2e test for eviction-induced cold compile storms (owner: runtime)
- treat deserialization EOFs as transient with exponential backoff before compile (owner: model-loader)
- add alert: compile-retry-rate > 5/m per pool (owner: observability)
- add runbook steps: cordon nodes, disable warmup, apply fallback routing (owner: oncall-docs)
- add scheduled jitter to warmup orchestrator (owner: serving)

oliver-cs: will craft customer follow-up and timeline.

emma-ml-oncall: handing off to jake-eng-oncall for 12h watch. notes posted in pager.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity downgraded to S2 at 2026-05-10T04:25:00Z.

oliver-cs: thanks everyone. we'll publish postmortem tomorrow with timeline and mitigations.
